for senior backend roles in india:

**dsa** - medium level leetcode. focus on arrays, strings, trees, graphs. they're checking if you can still code, not if you're a competitive programmer.

**bc** (behavioral/culture) - this is where senior roles get decided. they'll ask about system design decisions, team conflicts, scaling challenges, mentoring. have stories ready about your 6 years of backend work.

**mc** (machine coding) - design a small system in 2-3 hours. think: url shortener, rate limiter, cache system. they want to see your architecture thinking and clean code.

the key: emphasize your 6 years of actual backend development work, not just the SDET title. frame everything around distributed systems, microservices, java/spring boot.
